description: This file contains functions and interfaces for creating and configuring Firefox profiles with specific preferences, including default preferences and writing preferences to profile directories. It is part of the Playwright project, specifically related to Firefox WebDriver/DevTools Protocol support.

classes.name: ProfileOptions
classes.description: Interface defining options for Firefox profile creation, including preferences and profile path.

methods.name: createProfile
methods.description: Creates a Firefox profile directory if it doesn't exist and writes default and custom preferences into it.

methods.name: defaultProfilePreferences
methods.description: Generates a set of default preferences for a Firefox profile, optionally merging extra preferences.

methods.name: writePreferences
methods.description: Writes preferences to the profile's prefs.js and creates a backup of existing prefs.js if present.
